description: Violations (code, path, message) of the 80 journal fixtures (13 valid, 67 invalid) that existed before the optional profile members (draft revision 2), produced by the validator at ODES main 08afffe0; the journal contract was unchanged on main until revision 2 (checked at fe705e87). The tests assert the validator still returns exactly these (the default path is unchanged).

invalid/absence-carries-destination-stat: an 'absent' observation carries an empty destination_state
invalid/accepted-observation-from-the-fu: observed_at is later than evaluation_time plus the recorded tolerance
invalid/accepted-observation-names-anoth: the accepted observation names the reconciled effect
invalid/accepted-observation-policy-miss: an accepted observation records the policy it was accepted under (max age > 0, tolerance >= 0)
invalid/accepted-observation-stale: observed_at is older than the recorded maximum age
invalid/accepted-observation-state-unkno: an observation in state 'unknown' is never accepted
invalid/accepted-observation-time-withou: an accepted observation has a timezone-aware observed_at and the reconciliation a timezone-aware evaluation_time
invalid/accepted-observation-with-reject: an accepted observation carries no rejection reasons
invalid/accepted-reconciliation-without-: an accepted reconciliation carries its observation
invalid/applied-observation-recorded-as-: an accepted 'applied' observation is recorded as result 'applied'
invalid/attempt-dangling-decision: attempt names a decision that is not in decisions
invalid/attempt-effect-differs-from-deci: attempt effect_id differs from its decision's effect_id
invalid/attempt-on-held-decision: a attempt requires an authorized decision with a binding
invalid/attempted-row-carries-acknowledg: a 'attempted' row carries no acknowledgement (empty object; the reconciled_existing marker is checked by the lifecycle rules)
invalid/authorized-decision-with-reasons: result 'authorized' if and only if reasons is empty and a binding is present
invalid/changed-input-without-read-attri: a changed input is attributed to an actual read in resolution_inputs
invalid/closeout-names-no-accepted-obser: a closeout names an accepted observation of that effect, state and time
invalid/closeout-names-no-attempt-row: a closeout names an attempt row with the same effect and original status
invalid/decision-stage-check-already-has: a decision-stage check has no decision yet (null); an effect-stage check names its decision
invalid/decision-undeclared-member: member is neither declared nor inside the extensions namespace
invalid/delegated-attempt-started-at-cha: attempt syn-attempt-1: started_at is fixed when the attempt starts and identical on every row
invalid/delegated-completed-journal-matc: completed journal check matches no resolution check
invalid/delegated-dropped-start-record: attempt syn-attempt-1 lifecycle lacks its 'attempted' start record
invalid/delegated-journal-checks-reuse-o: completed journal checks reuse one resolution check
invalid/delegated-reconciled-existing-fa: reconciled_existing, when present, must be true
invalid/delegated-sequential-checks-reor: non-overlapping checks are listed out of journal order
invalid/destination-state-names-another-: positive destination evidence names the same effect
invalid/duplicate-closeout: one closeout per attempt and observed state
invalid/duplicate-decision-id: decision ids are unique (the store resolves a decision only when exactly one row matches)
invalid/duplicate-vocabulary-change: a vocabulary change is recorded once
invalid/effect-identity-substituted: effect_id is the commitment of {proposal, grant_id, grant_revision} from the binding
invalid/extension-key-without-x-prefix: extension member names must match the reserved x- form
invalid/failed-attempt-without-reason-co: error is null on attempted/acknowledged/partial rows, a bounded reason code on 'failed', and 'destination_outcome_unknown:<ExceptionName>' on 'unknown'
invalid/held-decision-with-binding: result 'authorized' if and only if reasons is empty and a binding is present
invalid/horizon-commits-to-another-propo: the operation horizon commits to the same proposal as the binding
invalid/input-time-floor-key-not-a-commi: member name does not match its declared form
invalid/journal-event-names-no-decision: journal decision_id and effect_id must name an existing decision and its effect
invalid/journal-mode-binding-without-run: journal mode: an authorized binding carries runtime_authority
invalid/journal-mode-decision-without-vo: journal mode: the reason vocabulary version is recorded on every decision and refusal
invalid/missing-input-claims-commitment: a missing input claims no record commitment
invalid/observations-member-differs-from: observations lists exactly the accepted reconciliation observations (per effect, in order)
invalid/reconciliation-retry-eligible-tr: a reconciliation never establishes retry eligibility; retry_eligible must be false
invalid/refusal-on-held-decision: a refusal requires an authorized decision with a binding
invalid/refusal-original-horizon-differs: the original horizon equals the horizon of the decision being refused
invalid/rejected-observation-not-held: a rejected or unavailable observation is recorded with result 'hold' and non-empty reasons
invalid/second-attempt-lifecycle-for-eff: effect sha256:d19d83b15e0ec164f3da356fe7a1ecef64734724d7fd65265e91e95f2ffe2829 has more than one attempt lifecycle that starts with 'attempted'; observed absence never establishes retry eligibility after a prior attempt
invalid/tenant-id-without-generation: generation and tenant_id are carried together (tenant binding) or not at all
invalid/uncertain-attempt-without-closeo: attempt syn-attempt-1 is still 'unknown'; an accepted 'applied' observation of its effect requires a closeout
invalid/undeclared-member-outside-extens: member is neither declared nor inside the extensions namespace
invalid/vocabulary-split-into-one-code: version differs from previous_version; a split yields at least two codes
invalid/vocabulary-version-without-journ: a vocabulary version without a resolution journal (check_events)
